observation_interface.raw_policy: Keep byte-complete stdout/stderr and exit/signal. Preserve source and tool/binary identity; no trimming, line dropping, rewriting paths/messages, NaN coercion, sorting diagnostics or guessed ranges. adapters.eval_exact: For identical frozen expression, argv and diagnostic environment compare full exit/stdout/stderr to designated reference. Public repr strings and exact IEEE bytes remain observable; no float tolerance or repr rounding.
adapters.compile_witness: Same pinned source path for both products, explicit PDF target and profile flags. adapters.query_values: Only where CLI transport is established on both products/profiles. Parse specified output field without losing type/order/presence and retain full raw diagnostics. adapters.causal_successor: For unsupported historical query --features or compile stdin transport, oracle author freezes a named-source compile/assert or supported transport fixture before candidate. Same selector/subject/read graph must be demonstrated; assertions/sentinels must not replace the value under test or erase convergence/history. A metadata wrapper may observe its already-evaluated argument and return original metadata; it may not introduce a new context/query demand. Assertion failures during invalid attempts must demonstrably be discarded, not terminate before the intended A5 observation; serializability alone does not prove an assertion bridge. Compare fresh reference warnings with exact source map and final value; retain original diagnostics separately. Profiles cannot be omitted; env-based features require a positive enabled-feature control and negative control proving actual propagation.
adapters.architecture: Verifier resolves source definitions/call edges with exact path:line and hashes, compiler configuration and successful build, plus productive ownership. Static/bound paths must share semantic owner and parser; lexical name/regex alone insufficient, unresolved macros/call identity -> Unknown. adapters.closed_state: Real approved APIs/carriers and private Same/Different/Unproven operations are observed in compiled candidate tests in F. phase_policy.rule: Freeze all obligations, predicates, fixtures, exact semantic test bodies and binding contracts in C. Execute all available reference/baseline observations and all20mutants in C. existing_architectural.scope: M12 shared-cause property on actual compiled reference source/configs, existing data/operation feasibility and source inventory. Candidate ownership/callgraph verified again in F; reference graph not proof of future ownership.

candidate_internal.scope: Only specifically enumerated tests whose approved carrier or private operation is absent from the frozen baseline and cannot honestly be executed before candidate. Concrete test source/template and binding contract still freeze in C. All below mandatory final matrices must be covered before seal.

lifecycle.NotDue: Scheduling state only, outside Preserved/Violated/Unknown. Permitted only for an explicitly candidate_internal entry in C/D. lifecycle.due: At F no mandatory entry is NotDue. Missing build, missing binding, missing observation or Unproven yields failure/inconclusive as appropriate; never Preserved.
lifecycle.unknown: An actual mandatory observation required in the current phase that is Unknown blocks that phase. Deliberate opaque controls and the predeclared M20 negative retain r1 semantics.

phase_policy.before_seal_completeness: Verifier must reject generic placeholders such as test later: every normative clause/category is mapped to concrete frozen data, assertions, operation and executable source or fully specified test template. phase_policy.binding_policy: Candidate-only tests may use sealed owner-local test code and test-only access to the private real operation. A later binding may only supply mechanically resolved module/symbol/configuration paths from a predeclared binding manifest; it cannot compute expected outcomes, reimplement comparator/selector/fold, omit fields/cases or modify assertions. Independent verifier audits binding/source hashes and confirms real productive operation executed. Any semantic template/binding-contract change invalidates the seal; no new public product API is authorized.
phase_policy.raw_ledger: Each seal lists separately executed C observations and frozen-not-yet-executed F obligations, with cardinality/IDs and no combined pass percentage. Final receipt discharges each frozen obligation by real evidence or blocks closure.
phase_policy.private_opacity: Public context_reads_valid_for false does not distinguish Different from Unproven and must never be recoded as raw Unknown without evidence. F06 requires owner-local compiled test to observe the actual private relation variant via frozen test-only binding plus source audit. A separate public non-certification assertion is necessary but not sufficient for internal Unproven. Do not add public API or a second comparator to obtain the evidence.
